euv_mask_pattern.mask_file_ref: (downstream foundry handoff · GDS-II format · TBD post tape-out)

ald_recipe_steps.name: substrate prep
ald_recipe_steps.params: hBN wafer clean · O₂ plasma 30s · base pressure < 1e-7 Torr

ald_recipe_steps.name: RT-SC seed layer
ald_recipe_steps.params: MgB₂ sputter 1 nm · Ar 5 mTorr · 100W DC

ald_recipe_steps.name: ALD layer-1 (Al₂O₃)
ald_recipe_steps.params: TMA pulse 0.1s · purge 5s · H₂O pulse 0.1s · purge 5s · 200°C · 1 nm

ald_recipe_steps.name: ALD layer-2 (TiO₂)
ald_recipe_steps.params: TDMAT pulse 0.5s · purge 10s · H₂O pulse 0.1s · purge 5s · 200°C · 1 nm

ald_recipe_steps.name: ALD layer-3 (HfO₂)
ald_recipe_steps.params: TDMAH pulse 1s · purge 15s · H₂O pulse 0.1s · purge 5s · 250°C · 1 nm

ald_recipe_steps.name: ALD layer-5 (RT-SC cap)
ald_recipe_steps.params: MgB₂ sputter 1 nm · 총 sopfr=5 nm 완성

ald_recipe_steps.name: Ar+ ion mill
ald_recipe_steps.params: 200 eV · etch through 5-layer stack · Hex-SRR 패턴 노출

ald_recipe_steps.name: Ag/Au interconnect lift-off
ald_recipe_steps.params: sputter 5 nm Ag · acetone lift-off · linewidth 1 nm
